text:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up — want to propose a lightweight 'drain window contraction' protocol to reduce double-evict and stale-read races during prefix residency transfers. TL;DR: introduce a short coordinated draining window + a small backoff retry to avoid flip-flop between shards.

owen: can you sketch the states? curious how long the window is and who coordinates it. :thinking_face:

maria: sketch below. coordinator is the current owner (no extra central service). default window 1.5s, tunable per-tenant. idea is owner marks prefix -> DRAINING, accepts no new prefetches, continues serving in-flight, exposes metric `drain_inflight` and a boolean `drain_ready` once inflight==0. new owner waits up to window for `drain_ready`, otherwise attempts soft takeover with versioned token.

sasha: interested. how do we avoid a race where owner thinks it's drained but a concurrent read prefills again? sounds like need a prefill guard/lease.

maria: yes — prefill must check `owner_token` and `drain_epoch`. simplified rules: prefill only if token==current_owner_token and drain_epoch==owner_epoch. if owner sets DRAINING it increments epoch. prefill rejects if epoch mismatch. small code snippet: 

```
// simplified transition
owner: HOT -> set(DRAINING); epoch++
while (inflight > 0 && elapsed < drain_window) sleep(25ms)
if (inflight==0) set(DRAIN_READY)
// after window expires owner can demote but keeps short grace TTL for reads
```

julian: ok. what about eviction credits / memory accounting? if we wait for inflight to finish could we starve eviction and OOM on busy hosts?

anita: that's my worry too. need a circuit-breaker: if memory pressure high, owner should shorten window or force-demote and attach a `recovery_hint` so new owner can be more conservative.

leo: propose metrics and tags so ops can act: `drain_attempts`, `drain_time_ms`, `drain_forced=true|false`, `drain_rejections_prefill`. also emit trace id for the handoff.

owen: runbook idea: if we see growing `drain_forced` fraction + application errors, escalate to manual rollback of the rolling update and increase `drain_window` for that tenant. would be helpful if console can surface top offenders.

maria: agreed. also want a simple canary: add a smoke test that does handoffs under synthetic load and asserts no duplicate evict within 2s and no stale reads during takeover. ci-bot can run this on PRs that touch prefix code.

ci-bot: smoke: handoff-canary branch ran on canary cluster — 20/20 handoffs passed, 3 runs, avg drain_time_ms=420. logs at http://ci.internal/hand-off-3499991111

sasha: small nit: we'll need to update `prefill` path to return an enum instead of bool so caller can react to `REJECT_EPOCH_MISMATCH` vs `REJECT_OWNER_MISMATCH`. makes caller logic clearer.

maria: good call. example API: `prefill(prefix, token) -> {ok, reason}` with reasons: OK, OWNER_MISMATCH, EPOCH_MISMATCH, MEMORY_PRESSURE.

julian: what about cross-shard backpressure? if new owner waits the window and still not ready, they attempt a soft takeover but must signal previous owner to stop accepting new fetches for an additional micro-window to finish any straggling KV writes. sounds messy.

maria: keep it simple: we allow one soft takeover attempt. if takeover fails, new owner backs off with exponential backoff up to N retries and then escalates to coordinator (human) if tenant SLA impacted. we document the thresholds.

anita: we should also link this to billing/credits — long drain windows cost tokens. ops might want per-tenant overrides.

leo: will add dashboard tiles for `drain_time_ms` and `drain_forced_ratio` + per-tenant filter.

owen: can we get a brief patch outline? i.e., (1) add epoch + drain flags to prefix metadata, (2) prefill checks, (3) metric emissions, (4) smoke test + runbook.

maria: exactly that. i'll open a follow-up RFC with that outline and sample configs. sample config: 

```
prefix_drain:
  default_window_ms: 1500
  max_backoff_ms: 8000
  force_shorten_threshold_pct: 0.9  # shorten window if mem usage >90%
  per_tenant_overrides: true
```

julian: timeline? I'd like to phase: feature-flagged, canary 2 weeks, metrics in prod, then default enable.

maria: sounds good. I'll draft RFC today. tagging @sasha @owen for reviews. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: note: please include unit tests for epoch mismatch and a perf test for worst-case inflight drain.

anita: adding ops playbook note — "If drain_forced_ratio > 10% for a tenant, increase drain window or inspect memory pressure. Consider manual resharding."

leo: lgtm, will attach dashboard PR when metrics emitted.

maria: thanks all — RFC link will be posted in this thread when ready.
